number: 第二百四十八条の二の二
heading_en: Methods and Scope of Calculating the CVA Risk Equivalent Amount
summary_ja: CVAリスク相当額はBA―CVA又はSA―CVAを用いて、CVAカバー取引及び適格ヘッジ取引（CVAポートフォリオ）を対象に算出する。
summary_en: The CVA risk equivalent amount is calculated using the BA-CVA or the SA-CVA, covering the CVA cover transactions and eligible hedge transactions (the "CVA portfolio").
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company shall calculate the CVA risk equivalent amount using the BA-CVA or the SA-CVA.

An Ultimate Designated Parent Company shall calculate the CVA risk equivalent amount for the CVA cover transactions provided in paragraph (2) of the preceding Article and the eligible BA-CVA hedge transactions provided in Article 248-3-2 or the eligible SA-CVA hedge transactions provided in Article 248-4-13, paragraph (1) (hereinafter in this Chapter referred to as the "CVA portfolio").
